aiBudgetWindowHelp.message: The window is the accounting period both caps share, and it survives reloads: “This watch session” keeps counting across a refresh of the same episode, while “This hour” and “Today” are local-time buckets. Usage is persisted, so closing the popup does not reset it.

aiBudgetHelp.message: 0 means unlimited for either cap, and the two caps are independent. The count includes the context lines.

aiScheduleHelp.message: Pre-translation covers up to 10 groups within the next 60 seconds; 0 translates only the current line. Context defaults to 2 lines per side, used only for disambiguation.
